title: A Unified Equilibrated Flux Recovery Framework with Robust A Posteriori Error Estimation
summary: We introduce the Equilibrated Averaging Residual Method (EARM), a unified equilibrated flux-recovery framework for elliptic interface problems that applies to a broad class of finite element discretizations. The method is applicable in both two and three dimensions and for arbitrary polynomial orders, and it enables the construction of computationally efficient recovered fluxes. We develop EARM for both discontinuous Galerkin (DG) and conforming finite element discretizations.
